name: Hydrogen blending and repurposing of gas pipelines
aliases: Hydrogen blending and repurposing of gas pipelines
principle: Hydrogen is mixed into natural gas networks at low shares, or existing steel lines are converted to carry hydrogen. NREL's review finds only minor issues below about 5 to 15% hydrogen by volume for distribution, notes fatigue crack growth rises at low hydrogen partial pressures, and puts the longest-running US blend at 12 to 15% (Hawaii Gas).
